lines.en: label halloweenfour7:
scene norikutaikuioween1
: Rich families sure do have some weird taste in decor, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 有钱人家的装饰品味可真够怪的，是吧？

lines.en: : What do you think they are?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它们是什么？

lines.en: : They look kinda like...monks. But I’m not really sure how that would fit in with the Halloween motif.
lines.zh: : 看起来有点像……僧侣。不过我不太确定这跟万圣节主题有什么关系。

lines.en: : The great thing about the Halloween motif is that {i}anything{/i} can fit in with it. Which is why it’s acceptable for you to be a pirate and for me to be a girl who occasionally wakes up in the body of a man.
lines.zh: : 万圣节主题的好处就在于，{i}任何东西{/i}都能融进去。所以当海盗没问题，我扮一个偶尔会在男人身体里醒来的女孩也没问题。

lines.en: : Lucky. I’ve always wondered what it would be like to have a wiener.
lines.zh: : 真走运。我一直好奇有根小鸡鸡是什么感觉。

lines.en: : Yeah, they look fun. I feel like they’d be uncomfortable to carry around everywhere, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊，看起来挺好玩的。不过我觉得天天带着它到处走应该挺不舒服的。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine it’s any less comfortable than Aunt Flow coming to visit once a month.
lines.zh: : 我估计那也不会比大姨妈每月来访一次更舒服。

lines.en: : Word.
lines.zh: : 说得好。

lines.en: : So is this just what we’re going to do for the rest of the night? Comment on the Amamiya family’s decor and talk about wieners?
lines.zh: : 所以今晚剩下的时间我们就这么过了？点评 Amamiya 家的装饰，再聊聊小鸡鸡？

lines.en: : Well, what else are we supposed to do while we patiently wait for the guy we like to acknowledge us?
lines.zh: : 那在我们耐心等着喜欢的人注意到我们的时候，还能干什么？

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween2
: I’m afraid I don’t know what you mean, Noriko. I haven’t liked anyone since the crush I had on Io back when I thought she was a boy.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我不知道你在说什么，Noriko。自从当年我以为 Io 是男生、对她有过一段暗恋之后，我就没喜欢过任何人了。

lines.en: : Do you ever get exhausted? Having to ignore it, I mean.
lines.zh: : 你会不会觉得累？我是说，一直装作不在意。

lines.en: : Ignore what? I do not like anyone, so I do not know what you are referring to.
lines.zh: : 装作不在意什么？我没有喜欢任何人，所以不知道你在指什么。

lines.en: : Well, let’s assume that you hypothetically {i}do{/i} like someone. And that person just so happens to be the same person that someone very close to you also likes.
lines.zh: : 那我们假设你{i}确实{/i}喜欢上了某个人。而那个人恰好也是你很亲近的另一个人喜欢的人。

lines.en: : How long do you think it would take you to, like...give up?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你要多久才会……放弃？

lines.en: : I suppose that depends entirely on how much I hypothetically like this hypothetical person.
lines.zh: : 我想这完全取决于我假设中有多喜欢这个假设的人。

lines.en: : Then, how long do you think it would take for you to start feeling tired and helpless? Or like you’re trying to run through quicksand because you never learned how it works and are now face to face with death.
lines.zh: : 那么，你觉得多久之后你会开始感到疲惫和无助？或者像是在流沙里奔跑——因为你从没学过流沙该怎么跑，现在却直面死亡。

lines.en: : Is that you how you feel, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 你就是这么感觉的吗，Noriko？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Yeah, it is.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是的。

lines.en: : I don’t want to speak for you, but I’m exhausted.
lines.zh: : 我不想替你说话，但我累了。

lines.en: : I keep telling myself all of this stuff about how I’m going to be the one to take a step forward but, when push comes to shove, all I do is stand still and wait for {i}him{/i} to...back up.
lines.zh: : 我一遍遍告诉自己，这次由我来迈出那一步，可真到了紧要关头，我做的只是站在原地，等着{i}他{/i}……折回来。

lines.en: : Standing still beats walking away. Which is probably what {i}I’d{/i} hypothetically do in this hypothetical scenario.
lines.zh: : 站着不动总好过转身走开。而这大概就是{i}我{/i}在这个假设情境里会做的事。

lines.en: : It kind of sucks that we have to go through all this extra shit just because we’re selfless, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 就因为我们无私，就得受这些额外的罪，想想还挺糟的，不是吗？

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween3
: You really think that’s it?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得是这个原因？

lines.en: : What else would it be? It’s not like we’re bad people.
lines.zh: : 那还能是什么？我们又不是坏人。

lines.en: : What’s that thing Christians have to do to make up for their sins or whatever? Pennants...or something?
lines.zh: : 基督徒为了赎罪什么的要做那个叫什么来着？锦旗……还是什么的？

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween4
: Penance. But what does that have to do with anything? Because I have a hard time believing someone like you has done anything to warrant drowning yourself in Our Fathers.
lines.zh: : 补赎。可这跟什么有关系？我很难相信你这样的人会做过什么需要用《我们的父》把自己淹掉的事。

lines.en: : Keep your dad away from me. I’m just saying that...hypothetically, if I was ever in the kind of situation you’re talking about, I’d probably just assume it was punishment for something I did.
lines.zh: : 把你爸从我身边弄走。我只是说……假设我要是真的遇上你说的那种情况，我大概会直接把它当成对我做过什么的惩罚。

lines.en: : Do you believe in that kind of stuff? God...spirituality...whatever you want to call it?
lines.zh: : 你信这些东西吗？上帝……灵性……随便你怎么叫它？

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween5
: I think so.
lines.zh: : 我想是信的。

lines.en: : But sometimes I feel like I only think that way because I’m afraid of what would happen if none of it’s true.
lines.zh: : 但有时候我觉得，我之所以这么想，只是因为害怕万一这一切都不是真的会怎样。

lines.en: : Like, what if we really {i}are{/i} just...alone? What if this is all we get?
lines.zh: : 比如说，万一我们{i}真的就只是{/i}……孤独的呢？万一我们拥有的只有这些呢？

lines.en: : If this is all we get, it makes the way we’re acting now all the more terrifying.
lines.zh: : 如果我们拥有的只有这些，那我们现在的行为方式就显得更加可怕了。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween6
: It really does...doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 确实……不是吗？

lines.en: : Hypothetically, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，假设性地讲。

lines.en: : How long have you loved him?
lines.zh: : 你爱他多久了？

lines.en: : Not nearly as long as you.
lines.zh: : 远没有你久。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween7
: So what? It’s not like that gives me dibs on his heart.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？这又不能让我对他的心拥有优先权。

lines.en: : I know...I know. I just...
lines.zh: : 我知道……我知道。我只是……

lines.en: : I feel like...saying anything at all about this while standing next to {i}you{/i} will make me sound like an idiot when you’ve been down bad for the guy since before Aunt Flow even met you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……站在{i}你{/i}身边说这些，会让我听起来像个傻子——毕竟你早在大姨妈认识你之前就为他神魂颠倒了。

lines.en: : Again...so what?
lines.zh: : 再说一遍……那又怎样？

lines.en: : Do you really think I’m the type of person to think less of you for your {i}feelings?{/i} You or anyone else could probably spit in my face and I’d {i}still{/i} jump in front of a train for you because {i}I’m{/i} an idiot.
lines.zh: : 你真以为我是那种会因为你的{i}感情{/i}就看轻你的人吗？你或者任何别人往我脸上吐口水，我{i}照样{/i}会为你挡火车，因为{i}我{/i}是个傻子。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween8
: How long have you known?...About me, I mean. And...the way {i}I{/i} feel? Because I haven’t even told Io yet.
lines.zh: : 你知道多久了？……我是说，关于我的事。还有……{i}我{/i}的感受？因为我连 Io 都还没说。

lines.en: : When you spend as much time in front of the mirror as I do, you wind up getting a little too familiar with how it looks to be in love.
lines.zh: : 你要是像我一样花那么多时间照镜子，就会对「陷入爱里是什么样子」熟悉得有点过头了。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween9
: And I figured if it was going to be anyone from the class, it’d be him.
lines.zh: : 而且我猜，如果是班上的某个人，那一定是他。

lines.en: : How’d you figure that? I like girls too, you know.
lines.zh: : 你凭什么这么猜？我也喜欢女生啊，你知道的。

lines.en: : Because it’s always him.
lines.zh: : 因为每次都是他。

lines.en: : You know, maybe this is {i}my{/i} penance.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许这就是{i}我的{/i}补赎。

lines.en: : Maybe in some other life, I did something really terrible.
lines.zh: : 也许在另一个人生里，我做过什么很可怕的事。

lines.en: : And God’s way of making me pay for it is by forcing me to watch everyone I know fall for the same person I fell for...
lines.zh: : 而上帝让我为此付出代价的方式，就是逼我看着身边所有人，一个个爱上和我爱上同一个人……

lines.en: : And giving me everything I could ever need in life except the one thing I want.
lines.zh: : 还给了我人生中可能需要的一切，唯独不给我想得到的那样东西。

lines.en: : {i}Courage.{/i}
: The ability to actually {i}do{/i} something.
lines.zh: : 真正去{i}做{/i}点什么的能力。

lines.en: : You’ve done way more than I have, Noriko. You’ve been chasing after the guy for years. That takes guts. That takes {i}strength.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你做的比我多太多了，Noriko。你追了他好几年。那需要胆量。那需要{i}力量{/i}。

lines.en: : And yet, we’re both in the same exact position...Staring up at the same weird statue and waiting for the same weird guy to come up to us and tell us he’s made a choice.
lines.zh: : 可我们俩现在处在同一模一样的位置……抬头看着同一座奇怪的雕像，等着同一个奇怪的男人走过来，告诉我们他做出了选择。

lines.en: : So, I’ll ask you again-
lines.zh: : 那么，我再问你一次-

lines.en: : Do you ever get exhausted? Having to ignore it.
lines.zh: : 你会不会觉得累？一直装作不在意。

lines.en: : Does it ever tire you out pretending that everything’s okay when you know it’s not?
lines.zh: : 明明知道一切都不好，却要假装一切都好，会不会让你筋疲力尽？

lines.en: : Does it hurt having to trick yourself into thinking this is just how this kind of stuff is supposed to work? And that it’ll all be over before you know it?
lines.zh: : 骗自己说「这种事本来就是这样的」，而且「不知不觉就会结束」，会不会疼？

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween10
: Yeah.
: It’s way harder than I ever expected it to be. And I feel like I barely even know him, so I can only imagine what it’s like for you.
lines.zh: : 这比我预想的要难得多。而且我觉得我几乎都不了解他，所以我只能想象你是什么感受。

lines.en: : You don’t need to imagine it. You already feel it. And I’m sure it stings just as much for you as it does for me.
lines.zh: : 你不用想象。你已经在感受了。而且我敢肯定，你和我一样疼。

lines.en: : I’ve just had the misfortune of feeling that sting a few more times.
lines.zh: : 只是我不幸多疼了几次。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween11
: Noriko...can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : Noriko……我能问你件事吗？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Why are you being so nice to me about this? Shouldn’t you be at least a {i}little{/i} upset that I’m pining after the same guy as you? Cause you’re practically giving me a pep-talk here.
lines.zh: : 你为什么在这件事上对我这么好？我和你苦恋同一个人，你至少该{i}有点{/i}不高兴吧？因为你现在简直是在给我做动员讲话。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}practically,{/i} Uta. That’s exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}简直{/i}，Uta。我就是在做动员讲话。

lines.en: : You and I are cut from the same cloth. And somewhere along the inseam, we decided it was okay to suffer so long as it meant those we care about could get a little reprieve from the pain of falling in love.
lines.zh: : 你和我是一块布裁出来的。而在内缝的某处，我们认定：只要我们关心的人能从坠入爱河的痛苦里稍得喘息，我们自己受苦也没关系。

lines.en: : And, like the martyr I am, that’s exactly what I’m doing for {i}you.{/i} But it’s not out of necessity or some sort of ingrained responsibility that I just decided to have one day.
lines.zh: : 而就像我这个殉道者一样，这正是我现在为{i}你{/i}做的事。但这不是出于必要，也不是我某天突然决定要背负的什么固有责任。

lines.en: : I want you to be happy.
lines.zh: : 我想让你幸福。

lines.en: : And it will never be my place to tell you that you can’t.
lines.zh: : 而我永远没有资格告诉你，你不可以。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween12
: Chin up, kid.
lines.zh: : 抬起头来，小家伙。

lines.en: : You’ve got a long ride ahead of you.
lines.zh: : 你前面还有很长的路要走。

lines.en: : Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……

lines.en: : You know...things have been really hard lately.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……最近日子真的很难。

lines.en: : And every single day, I tell myself they’re going to get better or easier, but...they never do.
lines.zh: : 每一天我都告诉自己，事情会好起来、会变轻松，但……从来没有。

lines.en: : But even with all of the pain I...the pain {i}we’ve{/i} felt along the way...
lines.zh: : 但即便有我……有{i}我们{/i}一路走来感受到的所有痛苦……

lines.en: : There’s one thing that holds true.
lines.zh: : 有一件事始终不变。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m glad our other school disappeared.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴我们原来的学校消失了。

lines.en: : And I’m glad to have met all of you.
lines.zh: : 也很高兴能遇见你们所有人。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween13
Two girls place.
lines.zh: 两个女生的地方。

lines.en: One green, one brownish. Both small.
lines.zh: 一个绿色，一个偏棕。都很小。

lines.en: One like the sex, other like the hammer.
lines.zh: 一个喜欢性，另一个喜欢锤子。

lines.en: They have talk about a thing they got in common.
lines.zh: 她们聊了聊彼此的共同点。

lines.en: Good talk about a bad thing.
lines.zh: 关于一件坏事的好好聊聊。

lines.en: Miku make the word feel light, Io make the light feel dark.
lines.zh: Miku 让话语变轻，Io 让光变暗。

lines.en: Anyway here’s the rest of scene.
lines.zh: 总之，这是这场戏的剩下部分。

lines.en: Please don’t mind the rabbit.
lines.zh: 请别在意那只兔子。

lines.en: : So, how’s it feel to be an official member of the purely transactional “Feelings in Exchange for Pills” club?
lines.zh: : 那么，成为纯粹交易性质的「用感情换药片」俱乐部的正式会员，感觉如何？

lines.en: : Kinda weird, not gonna lie. I ain’t ever been good at, like...{i}actually{/i} talkin’ about stuff. But the doctor says it’s okay if I go at my own pace for a while.
lines.zh: : 说实话有点怪。我从来就不擅长，那个……{i}真的{/i}去聊些什么。不过医生说我可以先按自己的节奏来一阵子。

lines.en: : The trick is to drag that out for as long as possible and then swap therapists right when they start to be all like “Grrr you still haven’t told me {i}anything{/i} yet!”
lines.zh: : 诀窍就是尽量把这个过程拖长，然后在他们开始「吼——你{i}什么{/i}都还没跟我说！」的时候，立刻换个心理医生。

lines.en: : That way, you can perpetually avoid ever having to open up to anyone while {i}still{/i} gaining all of the benefits of being properly medicated. Hooray.
lines.zh: : 这样你就能永远不必对任何人敞开心扉，同时{i}照样{/i}享受规范用药的所有好处。万岁。

lines.en: : So, what do they have you on? Is it the same thing I was giving you?
lines.zh: : 那么，他们给你开了什么？和我之前给你的是同一种吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think so...but I can’t really pronounce whatever it is.
lines.zh: : 应该不是……不过那名字我根本念不出来。

lines.en: : Is it working? You seem fine right now. But I also seem fine a lot of the time when, on the inside, I’m like four hours into a panic attack.
lines.zh: : 有效果吗？你现在看起来还不错。不过我也经常看起来没事，其实内心已经惊恐发作了四个小时。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween14
: It definitely ain’t as strong, but...I think that might be kinda good since I got a little...carried away with the other stuff after a while.
lines.zh: : 肯定没那么强效，不过……我觉得这也许是好事，因为我后来对之前那些东西有点……上头了。

lines.en: : The doctor says I might have to try a few different things before I find the “right one for me.” But I ain’t really sure how long that’s supposed to take.
lines.zh: : 医生说，在找到「适合我的那种」之前，我可能得试几种不同的药。但我真不知道这得花多久。

lines.en: : Anywhere from a few weeks to years. But hey, here’s hoping it’s not the latter.
lines.zh: : 从几周到几年不等。不过，嘿，希望不会是后者。

lines.en: : Yeah...here’s hoping.
lines.zh: : 嗯……希望吧。

lines.en: : Welp, I guess that’s the end of Dr. Io. Sensei’s sure to be happy. I feel like he was getting close to disowning me.
lines.zh: : 唉，看来 Io 医生到此为止了。Sensei 肯定高兴坏了。我感觉他都快要不认我这个学生了。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween15
: Make that two of us. I can’t remember much’a what happened when things got really bad, but I {i}do{/i} remember sayin’ a bunch of messed up stuff to him and, like...kinda blamin’ him a little bit.
lines.zh: : 我也是。事情最糟的时候发生了什么我记不太清了，但我{i}确实{/i}记得对他说了一堆难听的话，还……有点怪他。

lines.en: : Yeah, drugs’ll do that. When they first started putting me on stuff, I wound up mixing meds when I wasn’t supposed to and threatened to kill my aunt after getting a little too messed up one night.
lines.zh: : 是啊，药就是会让人这样。他们一开始给我用药的时候，我把不该混的药混着吃了，有天晚上嗨过头，还威胁说要杀了我姑姑。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween16
: Jesus. That sounds a little intense for just mixin’ up some pills.
lines.zh: : 天哪。光是混吃几片药就到这个程度，听起来有点太夸张了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well when you’re bite-sized like us, a little too much of {i}anything{/i} could send you spiraling into chaos. Or even death. But hey, my aunt is alive and so am I. So everything worked out in the end.
lines.zh: : 嗯，反正像我们这样个头小，{i}任何东西{/i}稍微过量都能让你一头栽进混乱里。甚至送命。不过呢，我姑姑还活着，我也还活着。所以最后总算皆大欢喜。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween17
: Either way...I should probably say thank you and stuff. Cause if it weren’t for you, I ain’t sure if I’d even be seein’ a doctor right now. Ya kinda, like...opened my eyes or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说……我大概该跟你说声谢谢什么的。因为要不是你，我不确定自己现在会不会去看医生。你有点像……让我开了窍什么的。

lines.en: : Just don’t repeat any of that to Makoto cause she’s super pissed and doesn’t know you’re the person who was givin’ me stuff in the first place.
lines.zh: : 只是别把这些跟 Makoto 说，因为她气坏了，而且她不知道一开始给我药的人就是你。

lines.en: : Cool. Though, I’d be lying if I said I didn’t expect her to figure it out sooner or later based on limited context and the fact that you are currently talking to me in a crowded room.
lines.zh: : 好。不过要是我说我没料到她迟早会想明白，那就是我在撒谎——毕竟线索就那么点，而且你现在正挤在一屋子人里跟我说话。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween18
: You’ve got a good point there. We should probably keep away from each other for a little while if we don’t want her catchin’ on.
lines.zh: : 你说得有道理。要是不想让她察觉，我们大概得暂时离彼此远一点。

lines.en: : Luckily for you, keeping away from people is my specialty. You won’t even remember I exist by the end of the night.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，跟人保持距离是我的专长。到今晚结束，你大概都不会记得我存在过。

lines.en: : Really though, Io...thank you.
lines.zh: : 说真的，Io……谢谢你。

lines.en: : I know this probably ain’t how you imagined this goin’ in the end, but ya really did set me on the right path. Ya just...didn’t do it how you were supposed to, I think.
lines.zh: : 我知道最后大概不是你想象的样子，但你真的把我带上了正路。只是……你用的方式好像不太对，我觉得。

lines.en: : For the record, this is pretty much {i}exactly{/i} how I imagined this going. But I’m glad you’re doing a little better now.
lines.zh: : 声明一下，这差不多{i}正是{/i}我想象中的结局。不过我很高兴你现在好一点了。

lines.en: : And I’m also excited to have somebody to talk about medications with! I’ll be the first to admit that they’re scary as hell at first, but {i}crazy{/i} interesting once you start learning about them.
lines.zh: : 而且我还挺兴奋，终于有人能跟我聊药物了！我先承认，一开始那些药吓死人，但你开始了解之后，就会觉得{i}超级{/i}有意思。

lines.en: : Yeah, I...I don’t really think my brain’s capable of understandin’ any of that stuff just yet. I can’t even read most of the words on the bottle.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……我觉得我的脑子暂时还理解不了那些东西。药瓶上大半的词我都念不出来。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween19
: There’s no need to rush. It’s not like anyone’s going to {i}steal me away{/i} from you or anything when I’m probably the least desirable person in all of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 不用急。反正我大概是整个 Kumon-mi 最没人要的人，谁也不会把我从你身边{i}抢走{/i}什么的。

lines.en: : They just ain’t seein’ the real you yet, Io.
lines.zh: : 他们只是还没看到真正的你，Io。

lines.en: : No, that would be a {i}good{/i} thing. The real me is the one that repels people. I’m like...manganese oxide polystyrene. But with green hair and girl parts.
lines.zh: : 不，那才是{i}好{/i}事。真正的我是会把人推开的那一个。我就像……氧化锰聚苯乙烯。只不过长了绿头发和女生的器官。

lines.en: : M...Mango...oxen...poly...stream?
lines.zh: : 氧……氧化……聚……苯什么的？

lines.en: : It’s used to make hydrophobic coatings for glass and stuff. Water can’t stick to it. That’s me saying it’s physically impossible for anyone to get attached to me.
lines.zh: : 那是用来给玻璃什么的做疏水涂层的。水沾不上去。我是在说，任何人在物理上都不可能对我产生依恋。

lines.en: : I don’t know about that, Io. You and Uta seem pretty attached from what I’ve seen so far.
lines.zh: : 这我可不同意，Io。就我看到的，你和 Uta 看起来就挺黏糊的。

lines.en: scene norikutaikuioween20
: Yeah...
: But she’ll leave me someday.
lines.zh: : 但她总有一天会离开我。

lines.en: : Or rather...she {i}should{/i} leave me someday.
lines.zh: : 或者说……她{i}应该{/i}在某天离开我。

lines.en: : Now, why the heck would ya go and say somethin’ like that? That ain’t right, Io. That’s just sad.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛要说这种话啊？这不对，Io。这太让人难过了。

lines.en: : It is sad, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是挺让人难过的，不是吗？

lines.en: : But...do you know what’s even worse, Miku?
lines.zh: : 但……你知道更糟的是什么吗，Miku？

lines.en: : The fact that someone like her...
lines.zh: : 是像她那样的人……

lines.en: : Someone so beautiful and kind and entirely unbiased...
lines.zh: : 那么美丽、那么善良、又完全不带偏见的人……

lines.en: : Would ever end up with me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 竟然一开始会和我在一起。

lines.en: scene black
: All I’ll ever do is hold her back.
lines.zh: : 我唯一会做的，就是拖累她。
